import GenDocProviderPromote from "/generated/pmc/provider-promote.mdx";

import GenDocProviderTransferActionPoints from "/generated/pmc/provider-transfer-action-points.mdx";
import GenDocProviderBlockchainAuth from "/generated/pmc/provider-blockchain-auth.mdx";
import GenDocProviderKey from "/generated/pmc/provider-key.mdx";
import GenDocProviderKeyList from "/generated/pmc/provider-key-list.mdx";
import GenDocProviderKeyAdd from "/generated/pmc/provider-key-add.mdx";
import GenDocProviderKeyRevoke from "/generated/pmc/provider-key-revoke.mdx";
import GenDocProviderKeyThreshold from "/generated/pmc/provider-key-threshold.mdx";
import GenDocProviderUpdate from "/generated/pmc/provider-update.mdx";

# provider

<GenDocProvider />

The provider command (`pmc provider`) consists of sub-commands used to manage providers.

## provider info

<GenDocProviderInfo />

The info command (`pmc provider info`) shows a provider's name, pubkey, provider tier, action points and nodes. It also
indicates whether the provider is a system provider, is active, and the cluster it belongs to.

## provider quotas

<GenDocProviderQuotas />

The quotas command (`pmc provider quotas`) shows the provider's capacity. For example, it shows the maximum number of
daily actions, nodes, and containers.

## provider quota

<GenDocProviderQuota />

The quota command (`pmc provider quota`) proposes change to the provider's quota. You can specify the provider tier
(`-dp`, `-np`, `-sp`), quota type (`-ma`, `-mc`, `-mn`), quota value (`-v`), and provide an optional description
(`--description`).

## provider nodes

<GenDocProviderNodes />

The nodes command (`pmc provider nodes`) lists all the nodes a provider is hosting.

## provider list

<GenDocProviderList />

The list command (`pmc provider list`) lists all providers in a network.

## provider register

<GenDocProviderRegister />

With the register command (`pmc provider register`), you can add a provider to the network. There are three different
kinds of provider tiers. A dapp provider is the most basic and default option if no provider tier is specified.

The dapp provider can deploy dapps and add nodes that replicate blockchains, and the nodes aren't able to build blocks
for blockchains.

The second kind of provider is the node provider. A node provider can add block-building nodes. Node providers have to
be enabled by letting other providers vote, the proposal can be created by using the option `--enable`.

The last tier is system provider, which is providers with system-level permissions. System-level permissions mean
participation in voting for updates to management chains. A system provider can, for instance, add proposals to add
nodes to the system cluster.

Example usage:

- Add a provider as a node provider, which also creates a proposal to enable this provider.

```shell
pmc provider register --pubkey <pub-key> -np --enable
```

## provider enable

<GenDocProviderEnable />

With the enable command (`pmc provider enable`), it's possible to enable an existing provider. Enables means that a
proposal of accepting the node provider is created for other providers to vote on. When the provider is enabled, it's
able to add block-building nodes.

## provider promote

<GenDocProviderPromote />

The promote command (`pmc provider promote`) promotes a provider to a higher provider tier.

## provider disable

<GenDocProviderDisable />

The disable command (`pmc provider disable`) proposes that another provider should be disabled in the network.

## provider transfer-action-points

<GenDocProviderTransferActionPoints />

The transfer-action-points command (`pmc provider transfer-action-points`) transfers some of your action points to
another provider.

## provider blockchain-auth

<GenDocProviderBlockchainAuth />

The blockchain-auth command (`pmc provider blockchain-auth`) allows using an operation from another blockchain to
authenticate a provider.

## provider key

<GenDocProviderKey />

The key command (`pmc provider key`) manages provider keys .

### provider key list

<GenDocProviderKeyList />

The key list command (`pmc provider key list`) lists all keys that are used by the provider to sign transactions.

### provider key add

<GenDocProviderKeyAdd />

The key add command (`pmc provider key add`) adds a key to be used for signing provider transactions.

### provider key revoke

<GenDocProviderKeyRevoke />

The key revoke command (`pmc provider key revoke`) revokes a provider key.

### provider key threshold

<GenDocProviderKeyThreshold />

The key threshold command (`pmc provider key threshold`) sets a key threshold that controls the number of keys that are
necessary to sign transactions for a provider.

## provider update

<GenDocProviderUpdate />

The update command (`pmc provider update`) updates information about a provider, such as the provider's name and URL.

# voterset

<GenDocVoterset />

The node command (`pmc voterset`) comprises sub-commands that manage voter sets.

## voterset update

<GenDocVotersetUpdate />

With the update command (`pmc voterset update`), you can propose an update of a voter sets governor. With the command,
adding and removing members of a voter set and updating the threshold (the minimum share of accepting votes that a
proposal requires) is also possible. All options create proposals for the voter set to vote.

Example usage:

- Propose adding a new member to the voter set

```shell
pmc voterset update --voter-set <name-of-voter-set> --add-member <pubkey>
```

- Propose updating the voter sets governor

```shell
pmc voterset update --voter-set <name-of-voter-set> --governor <name-of-governor>
```

## voterset create

<GenDocVotersetCreate />

The create command (`pmc voterset create`) creates a voter set, given a list of providers to include in the set. When
creating a voter set, a threshold is set: the minimum share of yes votes that a proposal must obtain to be accepted.

Example usage:

```shell
pmc voterset create --name <voter-set-name> --pubkeys <pubkey-1>, <pubkey-2>, <pubkey-3> --threshold -1
```

## voterset list

<GenDocVotersetList />

The list command (`pmc voterset list`) lists all the voter sets.

## voterset info

<GenDocVotersetInfo />

The info command (`pmc provider info`) shows the information about a voter set.
